description: Search Console clicks and impressions for each day of the last 7, 30 or 90 days (default 30), oldest first: date, clicks and impressions; days with no data are left out. connected says whether Search Console is connected, and lastSyncError appears when the last update from it failed. Null, with a hint, until the Analytics screen is turned on (activate_analytics_screen) or while Search Console is not connected.
name: get_search_console_trend
